text: The opening posting set amber10 to 10. The opening posting set birch11 to 20. ticket-s04 belonged to amber10 at the end of this batch. The delivery seal for batch 1 was copper-leaf.

In this notice, Harbor desk means birch11 and Lake desk means amber10. Harbor desk was set to twenty-five. Lake desk was debited two. ticket-s04 was transferred to birch11, effective before this batch ended. The delivery seal for batch 3 was violet-gate.
